what: A Track evidence bundle recorded by one of the first two builds that called their evaluator 0.2.0. A later build reworded one stage note without changing the version, so this bundle's recorded result no longer matches a replay, although every stage status and the verdict do. Tests use it to keep the documentation of historical replay true.
not: This is a test fixture. It is not an adoption, an endorsement, or evidence that anyone outside this repository ran Town.
